units.source_text: 正如古歌所咏：‘谁教君心似此愁？’”

en.t: Just as the old poem says, "Who has made your heart so sorrowful?"

units.source_text: 意思是反而恨明石姬不谅解他的心。

en.t: The meaning was that he instead resented the Akashi lady for not understanding his heart.

units.source_text: 此时公私各方均甚闲暇，源氏内大臣为欲专心修习庄严佛法，

en.t: At this time, both public and private affairs were very quiet, and Genji, the Inner Minister, wished to devote himself to the solemn practice of the Buddhist law.

units.source_text: 常常到嵯峨佛堂来作长期滞留。

en.t: He often went to the Buddhist hall at Saga and stayed there for long periods.

units.source_text: 想是因此之故，明石姬的愁怀也稍得宽解。

en.t: Perhaps because of this, the Akashi lady's sorrow also eased a little.
